description: This file defines a set of Sass mixins related to border-radius properties, including helper functions for validating radius values and mixins for various border-radius configurations used in styling components.

methods.name: valid-radius
methods.description: A helper function that replaces negative radius values with 0 by iterating over the provided list of radius values.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius with optional fallback, based on whether rounded styles are enabled.

methods.name: border-top-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-top-left-radius and border-top-right-radius when enabled.

methods.name: border-end-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-top-right-radius and border-bottom-right-radius when enabled.

methods.name: border-bottom-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-bottom-right-radius and border-bottom-left-radius when enabled.

methods.name: border-start-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-top-left-radius and border-bottom-left-radius when enabled.

methods.name: border-top-start-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies only border-top-left-radius when enabled.

methods.name: border-top-end-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies only border-top-right-radius when enabled.

methods.name: border-bottom-end-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies only border-bottom-right-radius when enabled.

methods.name: border-bottom-start-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies only border-bottom-left-radius when enabled.
